summary:
Orbital Architect is an interactive browser-based aerospace engineering and space startup simulation game that guides students from founding a commercial space company to designing, launching, and operating deep-space missions.

Aerospace trade-offs—such as mass budgets, Δv rocket equations, solar irradiance versus RTG nuclear power, radiation shielding, telecommunications latency, and launch licensing—often remain abstract in traditional classrooms. Orbital Architect turns these competing demands into hands-on engineering decisions across eight progressive destinations: Low Earth Orbit, Lunar South Pole, Mars Reconnaissance, Europa Ocean Explorer, Super Saturn (J1407b), Exoplanet Proxima Centauri b, a Relativistic Black Hole Probe, and a White Hole Outflow.

Players build their space startup across four commercial pillars, pass engineering and regulatory quizzes, tune custom spacecraft subsystems in an interactive Workshop, and manage real-time orbital flight anomalies and radiation surges across Standard, Expert, Hardcore, and Stress Test modes. By connecting physics, economics, and mission operations in an accessible step-by-step experience, Orbital Architect empowers students to think like systems engineers and aerospace founders.
details:
• Main Menu & 20-Second Launch Promo Reel: Players enter their aerospace company name, jump straight into gameplay, or play a built-in 20-second kinetic motion-graphics trailer synchronized to a 126 BPM procedural cosmic synthwave soundtrack.
  • Phase 1 — Space Company HQ (4-Step Startup Builder): Before launching flagship missions, players establish a realistic space startup across four pillars: choosing a focused commercial wedge (Subsystems, Dedicated Small Launch, Satellite Buses, or a Global Telecom Constellation), assembling technical founders with first-principles COTS vs. legacy manufacturing and static-fire testing, raising capital (Deep-Tech VC, NASA SBIR non-dilutive grants, and Government Anchor Contracts), and clearing regulatory hurdles (Spaceport leases, FAA Part 450 & ITU/FCC spectrum licensing, and ITAR/EAR export compliance). Interactive Founder Quizzes test engineering and business knowledge to earn non-dilutive SBIR grant funding.
  • Phase 2 — Destination & Difficulty Selection: Players choose from 8 destinations ranging from beginner Low Earth Orbit (7.8 km/s Δv) to extreme astrophysical targets like Super Saturn (J1407b), Proxima Centauri b, a Relativistic Black Hole (28.4 km/s Δv, 98% radiation hazard), and a White Hole Outflow (31.5 km/s Δv, 220% radiant flux), across Standard, Expert, Hardcore, and Stress Test modes.
  • Phase 3 — 7-Step Spacecraft Engineering Studio & Custom Workshop: Beginners configure one subsystem at a time (Launch Vehicle, Spacecraft Bus, Power System, Communications, Radiation Shielding, and Science Instruments) while monitoring live mass-to-payload limits, net power balance, and mass-adjusted Δv. Step 7 unlocks an Engineering Workshop to fine-tune auxiliary propellant tanks, generator wattage vs. radiator mass, custom Whipple/radiation armor, and flight avionics.
  • Phase 4 & 5 — Live Orbital Flight Simulation & Debrief: On an animated 2D Canvas trajectory map, players manage power reserves using Eco Mode, survive dynamic radiation/plasma surges, and resolve mid-flight engineering anomalies. Successful missions earn contract payouts, recurring constellation revenue, 12 Unlockable Advancements, and S / S+ Tier performance ranks.

    Benefits & Intended Impact Traditional aerospace problems often isolate orbital mechanics from budget, mass, and regulatory constraints. Orbital Architect bridges that gap for high school and university students by turning abstract equations into immediate visual feedback—showing why solar panels fail in deep space, how extra shielding reduces Δv, and how commercial space companies fund R&D before scaling to deep-space exploration.

Tools, Languages & Technologies Used

  • Languages & Markup: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+)
  • UI & Styling: Tailwind CSS with a custom glassmorphic deep-space mission control theme
  • Graphics & Physics: HTML5 2D Canvas API for orbital trajectory rendering, custom planetary/black-hole/white-hole shaders, and 60fps beat-reactive particle effects
  • Audio Synthesis: Tone.js (Web Audio API) for procedural telemetry sound effects, surge alarms, and a 126 BPM synthwave soundtrack
  • Development Tools: AI-assisted software engineering (LLM code generation and iterative debugging)
